fixes.explanation: Zion is a fine mountain, friend, and I'd bake a cookie on it any day. But the closing verse says the LORD established these laws “…through Moses on Mount Sinai.” (Leviticus 26:46) Moses is the one the LORD sent to bring His people out of Egypt (Exodus 3:10). Nice swing, though. You picked a mountain with real heart!

problems.problem: “Wrong mountain” says the baker's answer is wrong, which Papa Dorin must not do. “On this card” also refers to the lesson interface rather than speaking naturally to the baker.
